# Project Guidelines

## Repository State
This workspace is currently scaffold-only. There is no established source tree, build system, or test command yet.

## Code Style
Match the style of the file you are editing. Keep changes small, prefer ASCII unless the file already uses Unicode, and avoid unnecessary comments.

## Conventions
Add new project structure deliberately as it appears. When the codebase grows, update this file with the specific build, test, and architecture commands that agents should follow.
